subject: c-info
title: C.INFO.------TR.
description: Diagram in PCC-17, on the page where Braxton describes the Sonic Arts Union and Musica Elettronica Viva as the two principal collective extensions of post-Cage activity, with diverging affinities: SAU as vehicle for individual composer's compositional approach, MEV as collective improvisation. C-INFO (composite information) is crossed with TR (transformation): the question is what composite information's relationship to transformation looks like when the post-Cage continuum has produced both an individual-track ensemble and a collective-track ensemble. C-INFO → TR (the crossing). EXT-FT (extended functionalism) → PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) → MT-INFO (music information) → DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) → (R)TR-DEF (the reality of trans-definition). TR → PHY-U-P (physical universe particular) → EXP-INFO-B (expansion information basis) → AFL-DY (affinity dynamics). T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) → EXP-INFO-B in parallel. Structural argument: composite information reaches transformation directly, but transformation's downstream chain runs through the physical universe particular into the expansion-information-basis hub (which is also fed by time-continuum implications), and from there into affinity dynamics. Meanwhile, extended functionalism produces a parallel chain through progressional continuance into music information into dynamic functionalism into the reality of trans-definition. The diagram thus diagrams the two-track structure Braxton describes: the SAU/individual-composer track via extended-functionalism into trans-definition, and the MEV/collective-improvisation track via the physical universe into affinity dynamics through expansion-information-basis.
